notes.title: 🔮 Future Plans and Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
🔮 A bit about future updates:

   - The ability to save at any point in the game will be added
   - Bug fixes
   - Rework of the second dream level
   - Possibly! I might add another chapter to the current game
   - In the future, a macOS and Linux version is also planned

📰 Other news:

   - A sequel is planned (it will be 4–6 hours long, either as a major update to the current game or as a DLC)
